newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes strike in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes strike in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli planes raided suspected guerrilla targets in south Lebanon on Sunday shortly after guerrillas wounded seven Israeli soldiers, security sources said.
They said the Israeli jets hit twice near the village of Zibqine just north of the western sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone. There was no immediate word on casualties.
The air attacks came shortly after Moslem guerrillas clashed with members of an Israeli patrol, wounding seven soldiers near the Blat post just inside the border zone and overlooking Zibqine.
"The Israeli jets probably targeted the routes the guerrillas use," one security source said.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah claimed responsibility for the Blat attack.

Hizbollah (Party of God) is fighting to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 allied SLA militia from the 15-km (nine-miles) -deep zone which Israel set up in south Lebanon in 1985 to ward off guerrilla raids on its northern settlements.
